title: Dcypher Beauty’s Ruth de Leo talks 2027 expansion plans and growing her Beauty Concierge community
summary: Pure Beauty Award-winning founder of Dcypher Beauty Ruth De Leo tells Cosmetics Business about her plans for the beauty business in 2027, including retail and category expansion in the UK and US, and helping ‘rival’ independent beauty brands grow
